What? Why? That is one of the worst ideas I have ever seen.

- Developers should take funds from Silicon Valley investors via wire transfer through SWIFT, regulated by the United States Government: good.

If there was a ZCG foundation, the Zcash Labs model of bankrolling projects and hoping for a return from the coinholder vote would stop working.

Disclose conflicts of interest. This entire thread is a massive COI.

References:

https://zcashlabs.org/

Their "funding model": https://zcashlabs.org/funding-model , which outlines how the company bankrolls projects, then asks coinholders for reimbursement **plus a 20% markup.**

Billing coinholders for projects in good faith. A literal commission for development, billed to the coinholders. If it was ZSAs, then $1M of the $5M would have gone to @thowar2 and his coworkers.

Further, Tom himself stood for ZCG elections in Nov 2025: https://forum.zcashcommunity.com/t/tom-howard-for-zcg-december-2025/53294 . He ran on a platform to deprecate ZCG, but replace it with token holder voting, which would only further the Zcash Labs model.
